headline: Presidential order addressing the Interagency Security Committee, a group of federal agencies that deals with security at federal buildings.
what_it_does: This executive order concerns the Interagency Security Committee, a panel of federal agencies that works on security standards for federal facilities. No summary was provided, so the specific changes it makes to the committee's role, membership, or duties cannot be confirmed from the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and their security staff
who_it_affects.how: They may see changes in how the committee sets or coordinates security rules for the buildings they use.

when_it_takes_effect: 2023-11-27 (date signed; exact effective date not stated)
